specs.title: POST /api/auth/register creates a new user and returns a token
POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists returns 400
POST /api/auth/register without required fields returns 400
POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials returns a token
POST /api/auth/login with an incorrect password returns 400
POST /api/auth/login with a non-existent email returns 400
placing an order decreases the stock quantity
cannot order more products than are available in stock
cannot place an order with an empty cart — 400
cannot place an order without a token — 401
payment (pay) changes the order status to "maksettu"
cannot pay for another user’s order — 404
GET /api/orders returns only the user’s own orders
admin can add a product, and it appears in its category
product from the "old" category does not appear in the "new" selection
regular user (not admin) cannot add a product — 403
cannot add a product without a token — 401
POST /api/products with an invalid category returns 400
POST /api/products without a price returns 400
new user can register through the form and is redirected to the home page
already registered user can log in through the login form
incorrect password displays an error message and does not allow access

specs.title: switching between login and registration forms works both ways
the login screen has no logo or theme toggle
clicking the logo on the home screen plays the footstep animation without navigating away
clicking the logo plays the animation every time, not just once
clicking the logo on the shop screen plays the animation, then returns to the home screen
clicking the logo on the wishlist page plays the animation, then returns to the home screen
the shop header is the same height as the home screen header
theme toggle switches between light and dark mode and remembers the choice
cart shows a product photo per line and supports increasing/decreasing the quantity
the "+" button is disabled once the cart quantity reaches the available stock
user can open the dedicated favorites page from the home screen
user can remove a product from favorites directly on the wishlist page
typing a query shows a matching result with its name, price and category
search tolerates a typo in the product name
search also matches the category, not just the product name
search also matches the product description
a query that matches nothing shows the "no results" message
clicking a result opens the product detail view for the right product
pressing Enter with a single result opens it, same as clicking
the clear button empties the field and closes the results
the search field is available on the home, shop and wishlist screens
user sees admin product in the catalog and can add it to the cart
product with no stock cannot be added to the cart
checkout leads to the payment screen with the correct amount, and payment changes the status
admin sees the add product button
regular user does not see the add product button
admin can add a new product through the form, and it appears in the catalog
user can favorite a product and filter the catalog down to favorites
admin can edit an existing product and see the change reflected in the catalog
admin can delete a product from the edit form
